name: Virkoi
description: Virkoi was an aquatic world located in the Virkoi system of the Inner Rim Territories that housed a Imperial training academy known as Viper's Nest. Sinjir Rath Velus uncovered a plot to assassinate Darth Vader whilst on Virkoi.
